measured(command,cwd,env,timeout): command=list(command)+(['--ignore-scripts'] if Path(command[0]).name=='bun' else ['--no-scripts']) env=dict(env,JHOL_HTTP_TIMING='1') r=subprocess.run(command,cwd=cwd,env=env,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout);captured.append(r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr);captured_projects.append(str(cwd));return r,None m._run_monitored=measured;m.ARM_ENV['harvest']={'JHOL_NO_HARVEST':'1','JHOL_JGRID':'0','JHOL_JGRID_L0':'0','JHOL_JAGRS_MIRROR':'0','JHOL_STREAM_EXTRACT':'0'} rng=random.Random(2026100419);samples=[];rounds=30 with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='jhol-cold-prewarm-ab-') as td: root=Path(td);fixture=root/'fixture';fixture.mkdir() for name,data in inputs.items():(fixture/name).write_text(json.dumps(data,indent=2)+'\n') args=argparse.Namespace(fixture=fixture,fixture_lock_sha256=m.hash_file(fixture/'package-lock.json'),condition='registry-cold',bun=str(bun),jhol=str(candidate),node='node',timeout=120,drift_policy='fail') import re for rnd in range(1,rounds+1): for label in rng.sample(['before','after','bun'],3): arm='bun' if label=='bun' else 'harvest';args.jhol=str(baseline if label=='before' else candidate) s=m.run_one(args,arm,rnd,root,{},m.DEFAULT_MARKERS);s['variant']=label;s['raw_output']=captured[-1];s['project_path']=captured_projects[-1] s['project_times_ms']=[int(v) for v in re.findall(r'\[PROJECT-T\] total (\d+)ms scope=staged-file-project',captured[-1])] samples.append(s);Path('/tmp/jhol-h2-window-samples.jsonl').open('a').write(json.dumps(s)+'\n');print(label,rnd,s['status'],round(s.get('elapsed_ms',0),2),'project_sum',sum(s['project_times_ms']),flush=True) harvest/JGrid/L0/prebuilt/daemon disabled; staged extraction; same React18.2/react-dom18.2/Vite5 lock; OS/CDN caches uncontrolled','timing':'subprocess completion without RSS polling; outer memory watchdog; CPU fields include quality subprocesses','binaries':{k:{'path':str(p),'sha256':m.hash_file(p),'version':m._version(str(p))} for k,p in [('before',baseline),('after',candidate),('bun',bun)]},'rounds':rounds,'fixture_inputs':inputs,'samples':samples,'runner_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'summary':{}} for label in ['before','after','bun']: ss=[s for s in samples if s['variant']==label];passed=[s for s in ss if s['status']=='pass'];values=[s['elapsed_ms'] for s in passed] for s in samples if s['variant']!='bun'];report['jhol_before_after_tree_hashes']=sorted(set(s['package_layout_sha256'] for s in j if s['status']=='pass')) report['jhol_before_after_inventory_hashes']=sorted(set(__import__('hashlib').sha256(json.dumps(s['package_inventory'],sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest() for s in j if s['status']=='pass')) report['jhol_lock_hashes']=sorted(set(s['package_lock_sha256'] for s in j if s['status']=='pass')) # One representative build and executable gate per variant, outside timed span. report['build_checks']=[] for label in ['before','after','bun']: s=next(s for s in samples if s['variant']==label and s['status']=='pass');arm='bun' if label=='bun' else 'harvest' project=Path(s['project_path']) (project/'index.html').write_text('
') (project/'entry.js').write_text('import React from "react";import {createRoot} from "react-dom/client";createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(React.createElement("div",null,"Jhol"));') r=subprocess.run([str(project/'node_modules/.bin/vite'),'build'],cwd=project,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=120) report['build_checks'].append({'variant':label,'exit':r.returncode,'built_asset':(project/'dist/index.html').is_file(),'output':(r.stdout+'\n'+r.stderr)[-1000:]}) m._run_monitored=old out=repo/'docs/architecture/experiments'/('cold-h2-window-ab-'+time.strftime('%Y%m%d-%H%M%S')+'.json');out.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n');print(out);print(json.dumps(report['summary'],indent=2));raise SystemExit(0 if all(s['status']=='pass' for s in samples) and all(s['exit']==0 and s['built_asset'] for s in report['build_checks']) else 2)
